programme.desc: The Titan Games' premieres with an action-packed two-hour episode. Cari Champion and Alex Mendez serve as commentators.

programme.desc: Barbapapa wants to teach his children to make bread, but things don't go as planned...

programme.desc: Accompanied by Brigitte Rosset, Annick Jeanmairet prepares a fish ceviche with leche de tigre, an explosive mixture far more complex than lime juice, followed by fish paupiettes wrapped in chard leaves, steamed. Discovery of the day: chard fachon.

programme.title: Pistes Vertes Ep.39: Organic drive-through
programme.desc: In Granville, Manon and Manon have teamed up to create a drive-through offering organic and local products. With her association, Clémence collects food waste from canteens and restaurants to make compost. Near Caen, Isabelle practices zero waste in her guest rooms.

programme.title: Le Journal Afrique
programme.desc: All the African news from the TV5MONDE news staff.

programme.title: L'Actu
programme.desc: The televised news programme from TVMonaco.

programme.title: Le Journal De La Rts
programme.desc: All the news from RTS.

programme.title: La P'Tite Librairie
programme.desc: François Busnel honors emblematic works of French literature. Through his expert and passionate gaze, he invites the public to discover or rediscover authors who have marked their era and whose writings continue to resonate.

programme.title: Le Journal De France 2
programme.desc: The television news programme of the France 2 editorial board (8 p.m. edition, Paris time).

programme.title: 64' Actu
programme.desc: TV5MONDE's major daily news programme, decrypting the news! What you need to know: the Francophone view of the day's main events. Economics, social debates, international news: the expertise of our journalists. New weekend features: the French-speaking world, social networks, fake news, politics, sport...

programme.title: Allons-Y Franco !
programme.desc: Every Friday, journalists from the French-language media and TV5MONDE's partner channels share their views on current affairs.

programme.title: L'Invité
programme.desc: Patrick Simonin hosts the stars in the headlines, culture, music, film, books, an unmissable rendezvous with all those who light up our times.

programme.title: Histoires Et Leçons Ep.15: Fear
programme.desc: Each episode tells a tale from a different country. The stories travel through time and space and convey universal human values.

programme.title: Les Mini-Héros De La Forêt Ep.9: The tea party mystery
programme.desc: The gang of mini-heroes cherish the forest in which they live. So, whenever it comes to protecting or helping it, they don't hesitate to join forces and face their fears.

programme.title: My Class Ep.15: Determiners
programme.desc: Spelling, grammar, conjugation: these essential French concepts are approached by teachers in a fun way to help children aged 9-12.

programme.title: Woolly Woolly Ep.6: The marvellous wool
programme.desc: Every evening, Lila and her little brother Marco invent extraordinary stories whose heroes are five little gnomes. And the special thing about these gnomes is that they are made of wool and live in a fully woolly world!

programme.title: Ta Vie Sans Ça
programme.desc: What would our lives be like without everyday objects? In each episode, one of them is featured. Whether it is the suitcase, the stopwatch or the fork, they all have a story to tell about their creation and evolution.

programme.title: Jad Et Ses Soeurs Ep.23: Riddles
programme.desc: Twin sisters Ranya and Syrine are as adorable as they are inseparable. Their lives are joyful and full of everyday adventures. But everything is about to be turned upside down with the arrival of their little brother, Jad.

programme.title: Capitaine Tonus Ep.5: Why should we eat slowly?
programme.desc: How to eat well, move well, sleep well? In each episode, Captain Stella Tonus of the Body Fleet Federation journeys inside the human body aboard the vessel Positron. Her aim: to teach children about the beneficial or harmful effects of the things they do in their everyday lives.

programme.title: Compostman Et Moi Ep.37: Hearts in Bloom
programme.desc: Charlie and Zach live in an apartment building with their parents. One day, a friendly monster appears at their home... His name is Compostman and he is directly connected to the planet's needs. Thanks to him, Charlie and Zach will learn everything about ecology.

programme.title: Compostman Et Moi Ep.38: The Era of Change
programme.desc: Charlie and Zach live in an apartment building with their parents. One day, a friendly monster appears at their home... His name is Compostman and he is directly connected to the planet's needs. Thanks to him, Charlie and Zach will learn everything about ecology.

programme.title: Il Était Une Fois... Ces Drôles D'Objets Ep.2: The key
programme.desc: Watches, speakers, toilets... Maestro takes a fascinating look at some of our most everyday objects, both old and new. How exactly to they work? What is their history?

programme.title: Les Croquemoutard Ep.4: Neighbours' day
programme.desc: The Kiddycrunchers are a family of Trolls who have been forced to leave their home under the bridge and move into the Shoebox Housing Project to Iive amongst human beings! They discover community life and find that it isn't easy to live amongst these scrumptious creatures with their odd ways!

programme.title: Cirkus Ep.21: Turnips for all
programme.desc: To divert attention and notably any suspicion of sabotage, Tess tries to convince Aria that she likes the circus.

programme.title: 1001 Mondes Antiques Ep.5: Mayan beauty
programme.desc: Braillard, Colombe and Lablatte have discovered a way of travelling back through ancient eras and civilisations. They embark on a journey back in time, passing through popular civilisations such as ancient Egypt and Greece, as well as sub-Saharan Africa, the Middle East and Mesopotamia.

programme.title: Route Du Rhum 2026 - Destination Guadeloupe
programme.desc: Daily summary of the Route du Rhum 2026 - Destination Guadeloupe, a solo transatlantic race held every four years between Saint-Malo, Brittany, and Pointe-à-Pitre, Guadeloupe.

programme.title: Les Super-Pouvoirs Du Vivant Ep.21: The chameleon
programme.desc: The animal kingdom is brimming with creatures that have extraordinary powers. To reveal the incredible inventiveness of nature and the importance of protecting it, each episode takes us on a fascinating journey rich in poetry and humour.

programme.title: Mission Info
programme.desc: News programme aimed at 7 to 11-year-olds! Each episode, devised for children and their parents, provides insight accessible to younger ones, combined with explanations, immersive reports and expert interviews. An educational quiz also gives children the chance to test their knowledge in a fun way.

programme.title: Pistes Vertes Ep.40: Eco-construction
programme.desc: Focus on economical and ecological construction. On the vegetable side, organic market gardeners are developing. More and more consumers pay attention to local products.

programme.title: Chef Pays Ep.54: Saint-Pierre Market
programme.desc: Chef Louise Denisot prepares soba noodles with roasted butternut squash cream.

programme.title: Objectif Monde L'Hebdo Ep.8: Indonesia, Adventurers of a Lost World
programme.desc: The Tangkelemboke, on the Indonesian island of Sulawesi, is a limestone massif forgotten by maps. From November to December 2025, around fifty people, led by French explorer Evrard Wendenbaum, ventured there for the first time. Their objectives: to discover new species and uncover archaeological remains.

programme.title: Donner L'Goût Ep.9: Haiti in Montreal
programme.desc: Heading to the pan-Caribbean restaurant Kamúy, in Montreal. Its chef, Paul Toussaint, introduces Hélène to Haitian culture through its flavors and language. He also teaches her how to cook the island's greatest classics.

programme.title: Construire Demain Ep.3: The windows
programme.desc: Ultra high-performance windows are installed at Laurelle and Alexis' home. In Estrie, a visit is made to Olivier, Sabrina and Denise in their multigenerational eco-friendly home as they install multi-function solar panels.

programme.title: Suisse En Scène
programme.desc: Interview with a key figure from the Swiss cultural scene. An opportunity to look back at their life and career, and the foundations that underpin their work.

programme.title: Rassemblance Ep.9: Océane Dassé (Cameroon)
programme.desc: An engaged content creator, Océane specializes in textured hair and is the creator of the Curl Talk Show program. Born to a Cameroonian mother and a French father, she uses her curls as a pretext to create a space for education, self-confidence and identity affirmation.

programme.title: Le Match Dans Le Match
programme.desc: A key figure from the world of sport looks back at a particular competition, a career, an outstanding moment.

programme.title: Le Téléjournal De Radio-Canada
programme.desc: The televised news programme from the Radio-Canada team.

programme.title: Papilles Ep.11: Normandy by Arnaud Viel
programme.desc: Michelin-star chef Arnaud Viel has his feet firmly in bucolic Normandy, between the Orne and the Perche Regional Natural Reserve. The famous Percherons, camemberts, ciders and many other products come from this little-known region. Arnaud Viel reveals these gourmet delights to us.

programme.title: Hep Taxi !
programme.desc: In town or in the countryside, day or night, Jérôme Colin, the presenter-taxi driver leads his prestigious customer on a four-wheel journey conducive to secrets.

programme.title: Frontière Verte
programme.desc: Exploring the edge of the boreal forest, where the Arctic, alpine regions and ocean meet. This project is led by Karine Genest. The explorer is intrigued by the overlapping of species and their capacity to survive. With scientists and guides, she discovers the secrets of the wild.

programme.title: Tendance Xxi
programme.desc: French creativity is booming in the fields of fashion, crafts, design, beauty and gastronomy. 'Tendance XXI' showcases a know-how that evolves in tune with the times, sometimes even anticipating them.

programme.title: L'Épicerie
programme.desc: The place to be for all those who are interested in what they put on their plates and all things relating to food. The programme: reports, surveys, taste tests, test benches, answers to questions from television viewers, including advice and simple but effective tricks.

programme.title: Questions Pour Un Champion
programme.desc: A general knowledge quiz.

programme.title: Dîner À La Ferme - L'Esprit De Famille Ep.2: Morgane Siffert (Vaud)
programme.desc: Morgane Siffert is the daughter of Frank, from the 2011 season. At the time, her father was a tenant on the La Coudre estate. As his lease was not renewed, he has to rent land. Today, they have a small vineyard and produce natural wines. Morgane also grows herbs, vegetables and citrus fruits.

programme.title: Parlons Éco
programme.desc: TV5MONDE's economic news bulletin, presented by Vicky Bogaert. "Parlons éco" analyses today's major trends and interviews the men and women who are starting businesses, innovating and imagining the economy of tomorrow.

programme.title: Le Journal De France 2
programme.desc: The television news programme of the France 2 editorial board (1 p.m. edition, Paris time).

programme.title: 100 % Logique - La Réponse Est Sous Vos Yeux
programme.desc: The quiz that, rather than testing general knowledge and culture, tests the participants' powers of logic, observation and common sense. One hundred candidates compete for a jackpot that could climb to 100,000 euros. Who will manage to overcome all the obstacles and reach the final question?

programme.title: Opj Ep.11: Double or quits (1)
programme.desc: While trying to arrest a pickpocket hiding in a skip, Jackson discovers the body of young woman with a lacerated face. The investigation naturally focuses on an act of revenge.

programme.title: Opj Ep.12: Double or quits (2)
programme.desc: While the key suspect is the victim's ex-boyfriend, who had been harassing her for months, the investigation takes a sudden turn. The team learn that the victim has a double, who tells them that a recent attempt was made to steal her identity.

programme.title: Futura ! Ep.4: Nida
programme.desc: Nidonite, a young Instagrammer, doesn't hold back! And it's within her biker community that she feels most comfortable and can finally be herself.

The Agenda
programme.desc: Global Business is the flagship business show of CGTN English Channel, bringing you the latest economic data, business trends and policies.

A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and “accepted wisdom” to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda . You won’t find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today’s world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from “Prove That Climate Change Exists” to “Who Will Win the Race to Space”. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation. The Agenda: No nonsense talk; Challenging perceptions.
